name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.133.0 — The /spec:status default screen now carries every startable lane in its 🎯 Next block — escape entries first, then the parallel-lane fan-out with its merge-conflict heads-up, or a single pick marked 🚦 solo — so no runnable work is reachable only by typing --all. The 📋 All open work header is deleted; --all now adds only what you cannot start yet (🕓 after that, ⛔ blocked, placed under Next and ahead of the decide lines) plus the hygiene catalogue, and never re-prints the top pick. The footer drops its parallel count and reads · {n} more open / · nothing else open. A queued free-text item renders as its one-line id-led row on the default screen too. --next, --json, --pretty and --brief are byte-for-byte unchanged. 7.132.0 — ADR-0013: the client rehearses the journey. Direct landing of the sweep the record retires: candidate flows (specs/20260908/05) and the grid-in-client-mode draft (specs/20260907/11) are superseded, the dead variants:<j> stop routing is deleted from design-atlas.js and the review page header, ledger add/ask refuse --state so a question pins to a screen and never to a gray state, and the wireframe register moves from the flat zinc no-fills set to shadcn's Neutral component look on the same eleven roles (wire-tokens.css, wire.css, viewer.css value-equal) so a theme is a role re-valuation, never a redraw. 7.131.0 — A test that never finishes is now a bounded red rather than an unbounded hang: the host testCommand and gateCommand both carry --test-timeout=45000 --test-force-exit, and because a second reporter on stdout loses its tail under force-exit, the per-file budget reporter moves to stderr (its __FILE_BUDGET_OK__/__FILE_BUDGET_RED__ contract and exit 1 unchanged). New deterministic /spec:doctor check 18, port-check.js, walks every file under tests/ by location and reports each fixed listen() literal, pid- or random-computed port, and --port <n> flag literal, so the drift spec 06 removed cannot creep back; it is advisory in doctor and pinned green against this repo.
